sequence.subject: Stop retyping the same 100 employees every booking
sequence.preview: There's a faster way to book ClinicPlus medicals — and it's not on the ClinicPlus website. 100 free credits inside.
sequence.headline: You've typed this employee list before. Probably a dozen times.
sequence.intro: Same names. Same ID numbers. Same occupations. Every single booking, from scratch, on the ClinicPlus website — because there's never been anywhere else to save them. Until now.
body: ClinicPlus Booking Companion is a new, standalone tool built by Namoota Technology that sits on top of your ClinicPlus account. Save your employees once. Group them by site, shift, or occupation. Then book a whole crew for their medicals in the time it used to take to find one person's ID number.

It's not a free app — it's a credit-based power tool for teams who book often enough that the retyping has become a real, recurring cost of your week. So instead of asking you to trust a demo video, we're handing you 100 free credits to go try it on your own account, right now.
bullets: Import your people straight from past ClinicPlus appointments — zero manual retyping
Group by crew, site, or occupation, then book the whole group in a few clicks
Book one employee, a whole company, or everyone in an occupation — same effort either way
Every appointment lands in ClinicPlus exactly like one you booked directly — nothing changes on their end
sequence.footNote: Companion never replaces the ClinicPlus bookings website — you can still book there directly, any time, with or without it. These 100 credits are a one-time trial, not an ongoing free tier, and every action shows its price before you confirm it.

sequence.subject: What 5 minutes with Companion actually looks like
sequence.preview: Here's the exact flow: import, group, select, submit. No re-typing, no lost ID numbers, no starting from a blank form.
sequence.headline: Here's what changes the moment your roster exists
sequence.intro: Picture your next bulk booking. Twenty-two names for exit medicals, due by Friday. Here's that booking with Companion instead of a blank ClinicPlus form.
body: You open Companion, pull up the "Exit Medical" group you built once, and every one of those twenty-two people is already there — name, ID number, occupation, job spec file, all attached from the last time you booked them. You tick the group, confirm the service, and submit. One appointment, twenty-two people, a few minutes, not an afternoon.

That's the whole shift: from re-entering the same data every time, to spending thirty seconds picking who's going in. Everything else — job specs, compliance expiry dates, what you've spent this month — lives in one place instead of scattered across old emails and spreadsheets.
bullets: Roster: save every employee once — ID/passport, occupation, sites, job spec file, done
Groups: crews, shifts, departments, occupations — tick a group, not twenty-two checkboxes
Bulk booking: one company, one group, or one occupation, submitted as a single real ClinicPlus appointment
Compliance tracker: see who's expiring before it becomes an emergency booking, not after
Spend insights: what you've spent, on what, for which company — without digging through invoices
Multi-company: managing more than one client account? Switch between them from one login
sequence.cta: Try It On My Own Roster
sequence.footNote: Every action shows its credit cost before you confirm it — nothing runs automatically, and your 100 trial credits are still waiting to be used.

sequence.subject: Your 100 free credits expire with this invite
sequence.preview: Set up your roster before the next urgent booking lands on your desk, not during it. Last email in this sequence.
sequence.headline: Set this up before you need it, not while you're scrambling
sequence.intro: The best time to build a roster is on a quiet afternoon. The worst time is when your phone rings with "we need thirty people booked in by tomorrow." You know which one is coming first.
body: This is the last email in this sequence — after this, your invite goes quiet. Log in with the ClinicPlus account you already have, claim the 100 free credits, and import a handful of employees from your booking history. Ten minutes now, and the next urgent request lands on a roster instead of a blank page.
Nothing about your ClinicPlus account changes by trying it, and nothing locks you in — stop using Companion any time and keep booking directly through ClinicPlus exactly as before.
bullets: No new account — log in with what you already use for ClinicPlus
Import from booking history in minutes, not an afternoon of data entry
Every credit cost is visible before you confirm — no surprise charges
This invite isn't repeated — after this email, it's on you to come find us
sequence.cta: Use My Invite Before It's Gone
sequence.footNote: This is the final email in this invitation sequence. If Companion isn't for you, no further action is needed and you won't be re-invited.
